data.description: Observation-valued commitment with no covering evidence (daily/mini_fcl/cycle01/response#k2): Extend the no-blame miss rule to definitions of done themselves: a contested line is treated as the defect — rewritten together at the next check-in rather than adjudicated against past performance — and the trial is entered expecting recurring meta-disputes at done-lines, with a standing rewrite channel budgeted for them.
